title: feat(spec)!: retire TemplateManifest publisher and isStarter — the platform decides both
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi3Q621zfrgQodZHLx3cUop2)_

Fixes #31035

Clause-②: no (narrowing) — two authorable keys of `TemplateManifestSchema` become tombstones, and `os package publish` refuses the file's `publisher` by name
Metadata-protocol: narrowed
Skills-docs: none — no `skills/**` page teaches `objectstack.manifest.json`; the two `content/docs` pages that name these keys are updated here

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`objectstack.manifest.json` 里最后两个"写了不生效"的键 `publisher`、`isStarter` 改成 `retiredKey()` 墓碑，tsc 和 schema 解析都按键名拒绝并给出处方；blank 模板先去掉 `isStarter: true`，脚手架也会把这两个键从模板清单里剥掉；`os package publish` 遇到 `publisher` 直接拒绝，遇到 `isStarter` 只提示删除、照常发布。
- 为什么改：按你的裁决（#31035 评论 6708417668，选项 2）：信任等级是平台按发布者凭据定的，作者自己写的值从来不生效，这种声明不该放在作者能改的文件里；`isStarter` 同理由平台决定。前五个键已由 #31064 退役，这是后一半。
- 风险与回滚：收窄（BREAKING 横幅 + adr-0087 登记）。还写着这两个键的旧清单在 schema 解析时被拒；之前从 blank 模板生成的项目都带 `isStarter: true`，所以发布时对它只警告不拒绝。hotcrm 的清单和服务模式发布脚本要另开卡把值挪进脚本（席位立卡）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/marketplace/template-manifest.zod.ts`（两个墓碑和处方）；`packages/cli/src/commands/package/publish.ts`（`publisher` 拒绝、`isStarter` 并入删除警告）；`packages/create-objectstack/src/templates/blank/objectstack.manifest.json`（去掉 `isStarter`）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --project repo src/marketplace/template-manifest-inert-keys-retirement.test.ts`，预期 17 个用例全绿（七个键逐个拒绝、tsc 墓碑、两个 D3 登记、全树清单扫描）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **Spec (`TemplateManifestSchema`).** `publisher` and `isStarter`, inherited from `CreatePackageRequestSchema`, are re-declared as `retiredKey()` tombstones on this file only. A parse refuses each at its own path with the prescription `` `TemplateManifest.<key>` was removed in @objectstack/spec 18 (ADR-0049) — … Delete the key. ``. The publish request's own `publisher` / `isStarter` and the server `Package` row are untouched.
- **ADR-0087 bookkeeping.** Two `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` rows (`marketplace/TemplateManifest:publisher`, `:isStarter`), one new D3 semantic entry `marketplace-template-manifest-platform-decided-keys-retired` (its own family: the reason differs from the five inert keys — these are platform decisions), and its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (inserted where its id sorts, `order: 121`). No D2 conversion: this file is not a stack collection member (the `category` precedent). The sibling D3 entry's comment now points at the new family.
- **Liveness.** Both `template_manifest` rows stay `dead` (tombstone route) with REMOVED notes and `verifiedAt` 2026-11-07; `_note` and the README row updated; counts unmoved.
- **`os package publish`.** A manifest declaring `publisher` is refused before any network call (`retiredPublisherRefusal()`, the `visibility` shape). `isStarter` joins `RETIRED_INERT_MANIFEST_KEYS` and is named in the deletion warning, still publishing. `UNCARRIED_MANIFEST_KEYS` is now `['preview']`; `PLATFORM_DECIDED_MANIFEST_KEYS` and its warning branch are gone. Neither key is ever sent.
- **create-objectstack.** The blank template drops `isStarter: true` (the ruling's first step). `RETIRED_TEMPLATE_MANIFEST_KEYS` gains both keys, so scaffolding strips them; the pin keeps that list equal to the spec's registry rows.
- **Pins.** `template-manifest-inert-keys-retirement.test.ts` gains a top-level `describe` for the two keys (refusal per key, `isStarter: false` refused too, `@ts-expect-error` tsc pins), their registration and D3 entry, and its tree-scoped walk now covers all seven keys (same radius and `heldBy` registration as before). CLI pins: `publisher` refused with no network call plus a control; `isStarter` warned, not sent under either spelling; the key partition updated.
- **Docs.** Marketplace handbook callout and the CLI reference paragraph; `template-manifest.mdx` regenerated, not hand-edited.
- **Carried (comment 6701806800).** `taxonomy.zod.ts`'s module doc now says released values are append-only and retiring a released value is the ADR-0087 route; `taxonomy.mdx` regenerated.
- **Changeset.** `@objectstack/spec` minor, `@objectstack/cli` minor, `create-objectstack` patch, with both declaration lines, BREAKING banner, FROM → TO per key and the adr-0087 marker.

## Why

Maintainer ruling 6708417668 on #31035, verbatim in its binding part: "`publisher` and `isStarter` are retired from `objectstack.manifest.json` (`TemplateManifestSchema`) under ADR-0087, through the `spec-property-retirement` playbook." Measured on `origin/main` 9f61e06e6: both were schema members recorded `dead`; `os package publish` only named them in a warning and never sent them.

## Verification

Final head after merging `origin/main` (8ef4d309) and a full `pnpm build` (119/119 tasks): see the `os-dev-report` comment on #31035 for the full record.

<details><summary>Tests</summary>

- `@objectstack/spec` `test` (local project): Test Files 820 passed (820), Tests 25936 passed, 1 todo; `test:repo`: Test Files 91 passed (91), Tests 1556 passed. Re-run on the merged head: the pin file 17/17, `src/marketplace` + `src/migrations` 13 files / 347 tests.
- `@objectstack/spec` `check:generated` :: exit 0 (standalone); `check:test-typecheck` :: exit 0.
- create-objectstack `vitest run`: 25 files / 374 tests passed; `typecheck` :: exit 0.
- `@objectstack/cli` unit project: 394 of 396 files passed on the first run; the 2 red were `published-subpath-*.pin.test.ts` refusing a not-yet-built `packages/cli/dist` (prerequisite, not the diff) and pass after the full build, together with the three publish suites (5 files / 67 tests).
- `packages/apps/connector-{docusign,github,stripe}` `pnpm test`: 28, 14 and 20 passed.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on every touched source file :: exit 0.

</details>

<details><summary>Derived gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 114 families, identical before and after the merge; results and the `--ran` reconciliation are in the report comment.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Design choice the seat may strike:** `publisher` is refused by `os package publish`, `isStarter` only warned. This mirrors #31064 (`visibility` refused; keys the blank template shipped warned): no scaffold ever wrote `publisher`, so refusing it strands no project, while every project scaffolded before this release carries `isStarter: true`. The schema parse refuses both either way.
- `RETIRED_INERT_MANIFEST_KEYS` keeps its name although it now holds `isStarter`; its doc comment says what the list is ("never changed what this command published").
- **Out of scope, for the seat to file:** hotcrm's `objectstack.manifest.json` (writes `publisher` / `isStarter`) and `scripts/lib/marketplace-listing.mjs` (`packageUpsertBody` reads them off the manifest) move both values into the script, per the ruling. Not read from this container.
- `.github/workflows/release.yml` (governed) is untouched.
- Fable full review: PASS with should-fix, all fixed; two delta reviews (verdict comment on this PR).

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (touched files locally; repo scan is CI's).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
